title: Check Operator Station HMI I/O Diagnostics (VISU_IO_DIAG) for CPU/MB Temps, 24V, and Input/ Switch States
summary: Use the read-only Operator Station HMI screen VISU_IO_DIAG to troubleshoot operator-station I/O by verifying the displayed Control Temps (CPU and MB), internal controller Voltage Levels (expected 24 V), and the on/off status of the station switch and inputs. Use the input sections to open input detail information and use the screen drop-down to navigate to other screens if needed.
when_to_use: When troubleshooting operator-station I/O on the Operator Station HMI and you need to confirm that the HMI hardware diagnostics are reporting expected values for CPU/MB temperatures, internal controller voltage (should be 24 V), and the station switch/input on/off indications.
roles_and_responsibilities: L1_support: Navigate the Operator Station HMI to the read-only VISU_IO_DIAG screen and verify the diagnostic sections (Control Temps, Voltage Levels, switch/input on/off).
safety_notes: VISU_IO_DIAG is a read-only screen used for troubleshooting.
access_or_tools_needed: Tipper HMI / WebVisu / VISU access to the VISU_IO_DIAG screen

access_required: Operator Station HMI access to the VISU_IO_DIAG screen
system_preconditions: Operator Station HMI is powered on and the VISU_IO_DIAG screen is available

visual_references.description: Figure 4-27: Operator Station IO Diagnostics Screen (VISU_IO_DIAG) showing the informational banner, Control Temps (CPU/MB), Voltage Levels (expected 24 V), switch status (inputs on/off), input sections that open detail windows, and the drop-down menu.

steps.title: Open the read-only VISU_IO_DIAG diagnostics screen on the Operator Station HMI
steps.purpose: Access the diagnostic sections needed to verify CPU/MB temperatures, internal controller voltage (expected 24 V), and switch/input on/off states.
steps.instruction: On the Operator Station HMI, navigate to the read-only screen named VISU_IO_DIAG (Operator Station IO Diagnostics Screen).
steps.expected_result: The VISU_IO_DIAG screen is open and displays the informational banner, the “Control Temps” section, the “Voltage Levels” section, the switch status section (inputs on/off), the input sections, and the drop-down menu.
steps.healthy_condition: VISU_IO_DIAG loads successfully and shows all diagnostic sections (banner, Control Temps, Voltage Levels, switch status, inputs, and drop-down menu).
steps.failure_condition: The VISU_IO_DIAG screen cannot be opened, or it does not display the Control Temps / Voltage Levels / input sections as described.

actions.label: Navigate to VISU_IO_DIAG
actions.exact_action: Navigate to the read-only screen named VISU_IO_DIAG (Operator Station IO Diagnostics Screen).

stop_or_escalate_if: VISU_IO_DIAG cannot be opened or does not display the Control Temps / Voltage Levels / input sections.

source_evidence.quote_or_summary: NOTE: This screen is read-only and can be used for troubleshooting. VISU_IO_DIAG includes an informational banner, “Control Temps” (CPU and MB temperatures), “Voltage Levels” (internal controller voltage; should be 24 V), a switch status section (inputs on/off), input sections that open a window with more input information, and a drop-down menu.

steps.title: Check the informational banner for active alarms/messages
steps.purpose: Determine whether the screen is reporting any current alarms or informational messages that may explain I/O behavior.
steps.instruction: Review the informational banner at the top of the VISU_IO_DIAG screen. If messages are present, use the right-side arrows to cycle through messages.
steps.expected_result: The informational banner shows any current alarms or informational messages; if multiple messages exist, you can navigate through them using the right-side arrows.
steps.healthy_condition: The banner displays the current status/messages and the right-side arrows allow cycling through them.
steps.failure_condition: The banner does not show any messages when expected for the troubleshooting context, or the banner navigation arrows are not present/usable.

actions.label: Review banner and cycle messages
actions.exact_action: Use the right-side arrows to navigate through messages in the banner.

source_evidence.quote_or_summary: VISU_IO_DIAG includes an informational banner displaying alarms or informational messages, with arrows on the right side of the banner used to navigate through messages.

steps.title: Verify CPU and motherboard (MB) temperature readings in Control Temps
steps.purpose: Confirm that the HMI’s internal temperature diagnostics are reporting values for CPU and MB.
steps.instruction: In the “Control Temps” section, verify the CPU temperature and the motherboard (MB) temperature values displayed on the screen.
steps.expected_result: The “Control Temps” section shows temperature readings for both CPU and MB.
steps.healthy_condition: CPU and MB temperature readings are present and displayed in the “Control Temps” section.
steps.failure_condition: CPU/MB temperature readings are missing, not displayed, or the Control Temps section is not present on the screen.

actions.label: Check Control Temps values
actions.exact_action: In the “Control Temps” section, record/verify the CPU temperature and the motherboard (MB) temperature values shown on the screen.

source_evidence.quote_or_summary: The “Control Temps” section provides the temperature readings of the CPU and the motherboard (MB) inside the HMI.

steps.title: Verify internal controller voltage readings in Voltage Levels (expected 24 V)
steps.purpose: Confirm that the HMI internal controller voltage diagnostic reports the expected 24 V level.
steps.instruction: In the “Voltage Levels” section, verify the internal controller voltage reading(s). These should be 24 V.
steps.expected_result: The “Voltage Levels” section shows internal controller voltage readings with a value of 24 V.
steps.healthy_condition: Voltage Levels indicates the internal controller voltage is 24 V.

actions.label: Check Voltage Levels
actions.exact_action: Verify the internal controller voltage reading(s; these should be 24 V.

source_evidence.quote_or_summary: The “Voltage Levels” section provides the voltage readings of the internal controller of the HMI. These should be 24 V.

steps.title: Verify station switch/input on/off indications in the switch status section
steps.purpose: Confirm that the station switch and input on/off states shown by the HMI match the expected station behavior being investigated.
steps.instruction: In the switch status section (corresponding to the switch mounted on the station), verify which inputs are shown as ON vs OFF.
steps.expected_result: The switch status section displays which station inputs are ON and which are OFF.
steps.healthy_condition: The ON/OFF indications in the switch status section match the expected station behavior being investigated.
steps.failure_condition: The switch/input ON/OFF indications do not match the expected station behavior being investigated.

actions.label: Check switch/input ON/OFF
actions.exact_action: Verify which inputs are shown as ON vs OFF in the switch status section.

stop_or_escalate_if: Switch/input ON/OFF indications do not match the expected station behavior being investigated.

source_evidence.quote_or_summary: This section corresponds to the switch mounted on the station and convey which inputs are on and off.

steps.title: Open input detail window by selecting an input section
steps.purpose: Get more information about a specific input whose ON/OFF state you are investigating.
steps.instruction: In the inputs section, select one of the input sections to open the window with more information about what the selected input is.
steps.expected_result: Selecting an input section opens a window providing more information about that input.
steps.healthy_condition: The input detail window opens successfully for the selected input.
steps.failure_condition: Selecting an input section does not open the detail window, or the detail window does not provide input information.

actions.label: Select an input section
actions.exact_action: Select one of the input sections to open the window with more information about what the selected input is.

source_evidence.quote_or_summary: This section shows the inputs. Selecting one of these sections will open a window providing more information on what the inputs are.

steps.title: Use the VISU_IO_DIAG drop-down menu to navigate to other screens if needed
steps.purpose: Jump to other Operator Station HMI screens for additional troubleshooting context when required.
steps.instruction: Use the drop-down menu on the VISU_IO_DIAG screen to directly select/view other screens if needed for additional troubleshooting context.
steps.expected_result: The drop-down menu allows direct selection of another screen to view.
steps.healthy_condition: You can use the drop-down menu to navigate to the selected screen.
steps.failure_condition: The drop-down menu is not present/usable or navigation does not occur.

actions.label: Select another screen from drop-down
actions.exact_action: Use the drop-down menu that can be used to directly select the screen to view.

source_evidence.quote_or_summary: The drop-down menu can be used to directly select the screen to view.

success_criteria: VISU_IO_DIAG is opened and displays the Control Temps, Voltage Levels, switch status, and input sections.
Voltage Levels indicates internal controller voltage is 24 V.
Switch status shows station inputs with ON/OFF indications that match the expected station behavior being investigated.
Selecting an input section opens a detail window with more information about that input.
healthy_conditions: VISU_IO_DIAG is read-only and loads successfully for troubleshooting.
Control Temps section shows CPU and MB temperature readings.
Voltage Levels section shows internal controller voltage at 24 V.
Switch status section conveys which inputs are on and off.
Input sections open a detail window when selected.
failure_conditions: VISU_IO_DIAG cannot be opened or does not display the Control Temps / Voltage Levels / input sections.
Switch/input ON/OFF indications do not match the expected station behavior being investigated.
Selecting an input section does not open the input detail window.
escalation_guidance: Escalate if “Voltage Levels” are not 24 V.
Escalate if the switch/input ON/OFF indications do not match the expected station behavior being investigated.
Escalate if the VISU_IO_DIAG screen cannot be opened or does not display the Control Temps / Voltage Levels / input sections as described.
